title: Research: independently certify all P104 native chart identities
body:
## Summary

PR3406's all-role Newton entrance proof retains the native chart identities as an explicit premise. This adds a separate exact certificate for every archived PR2586 recipe.

```diff
 whole-word Newton source proof
- inherit 1,245 native change-of-chart identities
+ certify all 1,245 identities, including exact global phase
```

For all inputs in Q(i)^512, every stored recipe equals `Delta_new Delta_old^-1`. All 2,070 literal occurrences match their chronological frames and positive ranks. The rank mass remains 3,542. Only `research/p104-native-covariance/` is added.

The checker reconstructs canonical charts from binary frame columns and imports no predecessor executable. Exact signed Pauli action plus one complete nonzero column proves operator equality. PROOF.md gives the finite argument; RECEIPT.json records every comparison and source-bound occurrence.

## Evidence

- Before, PR3406's dense fixture did not independently prove the inherited identities on every input. After, all 1,245 exact operator comparisons pass, using 445 reconstructed charts. Every one of 2,621 distinct monomial maps has all 18 generator relations checked on all 512 columns.
- A separate Fraction evaluator checks 156 small words, 624 full matrix columns, 2,496 direct tableau relations and 32 additional signed Pauli relations. Global-phase mutants retain the same tableau and fail the exact column check. Wrong stages, frames, occurrences and malformed inputs reject.
- Registered normal and optimized Python 3.12 replays pass. All three direct commands pass in the actual committed, read-only Git-free export, with its 11 files unchanged. Real optimized CLI corrupt-source, missing-source and Boolean-receipt mutants reject. Scoped Ruff diagnostics and whitespace checks pass.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p104-native-covariance
```

Final head `f1112560883a5e81b1a29c37c81a79a20be31fe3` adds only neutral review-status metadata to scientific commit `06c1b12fc2256da559ffd81a05b0935b395f120b`. Proof, verifier, scientific receipt, source pins and replay commands are byte-identical. Final-head metadata validation and all three committed-export commands pass.

This closes one finite proof dependency. It does not supply physical input preparation, an actual consumer, owners, a favorable full bill, all-size transfer, a new kappa or a selected-frontier update. Human/proof-kernel review and the selected cold replay remain unrun.

Credit ywz65/PR2586 for the word, recipes and original certification; Tekalign/PR3218 for the established Pauli-plus-anchor criterion; Clear1nsight/PR3382, Ross Richardson, Nick Petalas/PR3406 and the retained native/geometry/compiler/precision lineage. Exact source pins and scope are in SOURCES.json and TASK.json. The active actual-producer/consumer investigation remains distinct.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009154).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

Eight new package files. Frozen inputs and the selected result are unchanged. The Python checker and written proof require substantive review; local passing evidence is not supplier admission.
